CustomField.description: When the guest was most recently asked for feedback - set by GxFeedbackDispatch as it prepares each invitation, and moved forward again by a reminder. Two things read it: the reminder pass, which waits Reminder_Delay_Days__c after this moment, and the survey's own expiry check, so a reminded guest gets a full validity window from the day they were last asked rather than from the day their trip ended. SurveySent__c only records that an invitation happened; this records when.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When we last asked this guest for feedback. Set automatically.
CustomField.label: Survey Sent On
